messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic optimization via semidefinite relaxation of copositive constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is uniquely determined (up to symmetry) by solving a semidefinite relaxation of the natural copositive program over pairwise distance and area variables, and the relaxation is tight: the optimal Gram matrix has rank 2, yielding coordinates matching a stretched triangular lattice with minimum triangle area exactly 1/96."}
